experiment_description: Perform transport characterization of a monolayer graphene/hexagonal boron nitride (MLG/hBN) moiré superlattice multiterminal split-gate field-effect transistor. Apply a small AC current and measure the four-terminal longitudinal resistance and Hall reactivity across the junction using a lock-in technique as a function of the left and right split-gate voltages and an applied back-gate voltage.

AC_current_RMS_nA.description: Root-mean-square amplitude of the AC current applied using a voltage-controlled current source.

lock_in_frequency_Hz.description: Frequency of the lock-in amplifier used for transport measurements.

fixed_back_gate_voltage_V.description: Fixed DC voltage applied to the back gate during the split-gate voltage sweeps.

experiment_description: Expose the MLG/hBN split-gate device to continuous sub-terahertz radiation. Measure the generated photovoltage across the device using a lock-in amplifier referenced to the modulation frequency of the terahertz source. Conduct these measurements at zero magnetic field while sweeping the left and right split-gate voltages. Repeat measurements at various radiation attenuation levels and operating temperatures.

THz_radiation_frequency_THz.description: Frequency of the incident terahertz radiation used to illuminate the device.

laser_modulation_frequency_Hz.description: Modulation frequency of the terahertz source to which the lock-in amplifiers are referenced.

calculated_incident_power_nW.description: Calculated sub-terahertz power incident on the antenna after accounting for optical path losses, attenuation, and cryostat window absorption.

cryostat_window_absorption_percent.description: Measured percentage of terahertz radiation absorbed by the cryostat windows.

experiment_description: Measure the photovoltage of the MLG/hBN split-gate device under terahertz illumination while applying an out-of-plane magnetic field. Map the photovoltage as a function of the left and right split-gate voltages at specific constant magnetic field values, and trace the signal as a function of the magnetic field magnitude by sweeping the field.

magnetic_field_sweep_limit_T.description: Maximum absolute value of the out-of-plane magnetic field applied during the photovoltage mapping.

experiment_description: Evaluate the zero-bias terahertz photodetector performance metrics of the fabricated moiré superlattice devices. Calculate the external voltage responsivity using the derived peak photovoltage and the calculated incident terahertz power. Determine the noise-equivalent power (NEP) by taking the ratio of the calculated thermal voltage noise spectral density to the calculated voltage responsivity.

voltage_responsivity_kV_W.description: Evaluated external voltage responsivity of the detector based on incident power.

zero_field_NEP_pW_sqrtHz.description: Calculated noise-equivalent power of the device at zero applied magnetic field.
